title: Solution set for a universe-enlarged Hom functor
statement: Let C be an abelian category with Hom types in Type w, well-powered relative to w, and with coproducts indexed by Type max(w,vH). For any G in C, the explicit functor X |-> ULift Hom(G,X) to Type max(w,vH) modules over End(G)^op satisfies the solution-set condition with indexing sets in Type w. There is no separator condition on G, no derived category, and no adjoint is asserted.

source.place: Lemma 19.14.1, first proof, images of sums; agent-written quotient parametrization using Mathlib CategoryTheory.Abelian.subobjectIsoSubobjectOp

proof.text: For a module M in Type max(w,vH), form P as the coproduct of M copies of G. By well-poweredness and the abelian subobject/quotient correspondence, choose a Type w list of quotient maps q_N:P -> Q_N covering all quotients up to isomorphism. Keep those for which m |-> i_m q_N is additive and End(G)^op-linear. This subtype remains w-small and provides module maps f_N:M -> ULift Hom(G,Q_N).

For any module map h:M -> ULift Hom(G,X), unlift its values to get d:P -> X. Factor d through its image as q followed by the monomorphism j:Q -> X. Linearity of h and cancellation against j imply that m |-> i_m q is linear. Thus this quotient lies in the restricted family. Its representative Q_N maps to X by g and satisfies f_N followed by the lifted Hom map of g equals h, proving the solution-set condition. The zero-object and zero-module cases use zero maps.
